# Retrieve cached hotel search results for Las Vegas with beach access

    prior_results=departure_flights,
    start_airport_city="Memphis",
    end_airport_city="Las Vegas",
    departure_date=["2025-05-16"]
)

    prior_results=return_flights,
    start_airport_city="Las Vegas",
    end_airport_city="Memphis",
    departure_date=["2025-05-29"]
)

)

)

    results=outbound_flights,
    column="economy_class_price",

)

    column="economy_class_price",
    ascending=True
)

)
